comment: Solar wind speeds have returned to background levels, and QUIET geomagnetic conditions are expected to continue throughout the first forecast interval. A full-halo coronal mass ejection (CME) observed yesterday, associated with an M1.4 class solar flare, is expected to become geoeffective during the second forecast interval (early on 9th OCT). This is likely to increase geomagnetic activity, with a chance of STORM G1 and G2 periods.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
